text:
Maria (Finance): FYI — spotted a chunk of AWS Marketplace charges on the Feb invoice that have no cost-center or customer tags. Looks like reseller/marketplace lines only. We need to allocate before month close. :eyes: 

Sam (Ops): Can you paste the invoice id and a couple of sample line items? I can try to match usage rows to our partner mapping table.

Maria (Finance): Invoice: INV-2028-02-12-MP. Problem lines below (redacted customer ids). Notably tags are empty on marketplace product lines:

```
InvoiceDate: 2028-02-12
LineItem: marketplace:us-east-1:partner-CloudEdge:prod-rtg-01  UsageType: TokenIngress  Qty: 1  UsageUnits: 12345  ChargeUSD: 12345.67  tags: {}
LineItem: marketplace:us-east-1:partner-CloudEdge:prod-rtg-02  UsageType: TokenEgress   Qty: 1  UsageUnits: 6789   ChargeUSD: 567.89   tags: {}
```

Maria (Finance): Total unattributed marketplace sum = $12,345.67 (system calc).

Nina (RevOps): Did these lines come through our usual ingestion pipeline? If the payload changed we might be dropping the cost_center field during transform. I can run the reconciliation script once you confirm invoice id.

Liam (Sales): CloudEdge partner says their customer's metering id is present on their side — they pushed it through marketplace. Can we map by product/resource id instead? Which field do we look for?

Audrey (Engineering): Quick check of the ingestion logs shows malformed metadata key for marketplace events between 2028-02-10 02:00-05:30 UTC. The marketplace payload used `customer_ref` previously, but the recent marketplace integration started sending `partner_customer_id` which our transform didn't pick up. Small snippet from logs: `WARN transform.marketplace - missing key customer_ref for line marketplace:prod-rtg-01`

Audrey (Engineering): Proposed fix: update the ETL step to accept both `customer_ref` and `partner_customer_id` and re-run the transform for Feb 10-12. I can open a quick PR and run a one-off reprocess if you approve. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Automated reconciliation report produced: Unattributed marketplace charges = $12,345.67 across 18 line items. Suggested action: reprocess transforms or manual allocation journal. Link: https://billing.internal/recon/INV-2028-02-12

Sam (Ops): If engineering can reprocess and restore tags, that will let RevOps allocate by customer automatically. Otherwise we'll need a manual GL/counterparty allocation which is more work. Audrey, timeline on PR + reprocess?

Audrey (Engineering): I can have a PR up in ~2 hours and a reprocess in the staging window tonight. It will take ~30-45m to re-run and validate. No schema changes required, just accepting alternate key.

Nina (RevOps): Give me a thumbs when reprocess completes. If tags still missing I can do a manual journal entry to allocate to partner CloudEdge for now and adjust later. Need approval from Maria for manual journal.

Maria (Finance): Approved for a temporary manual allocation to partner CloudEdge up to $12.4k if reprocess fails. Please tag the entry with "marketplace-unattributed" and add note referencing INV-2028-02-12. :thumbsup:

Liam (Sales): I'll ping CloudEdge to ask them to confirm partner_customer_id values for the affected customers so we can cross-check after reprocess.

Sam (Ops): Sounds good. Action items:
• Audrey: PR + reprocess tonight (ETA 23:30 UTC).
• Nina: hold ready for manual journal if needed; wait for reprocess results.
• Maria: approved manual allocation as fallback.
• Liam: confirm partner ids with CloudEdge.

Maria (Finance): Thanks everyone — please update thread when reprocess finishes or if you hit blockers.

Audrey (Engineering): PR merge done. Kicking off reprocess now. Will post logs here when complete.

billing-bot: Reprocess job completed (job id rp-7842). Result: 15 lines now tagged; remaining unattributed = $1,234.56 across 3 lines. Reconciliation link: https://billing.internal/recon/INV-2028-02-12/rp-7842

Nina (RevOps): I ran the allocation matcher against the reprocessed records. Two of the three remaining lines are missing partner_customer_id in provider payload — looks like those specific marketplace meters didn't include an ID. I can do a partial manual allocation: $1,000.00 to CloudEdge, $234.56 to Uncategorized temporary GL until partner confirms. Maria, do you still want to proceed?

Maria (Finance): Yes proceed. Make manual journal: DR Marketplace Expense $1,234.56 / CR CloudEdge Payable $1,000.00; CR Uncategorized Liability $234.56. Include note: "Manual allocation fallback for INV-2028-02-12; reconcile once partner confirms missing IDs."

Nina (RevOps): Journal posted: JRN-2028-02-15-047. Tagging for month-close.

Liam (Sales): CloudEdge confirmed two missing partner_customer_id values; they'll correct their provisioning and said they'll reimburse any adjustments if needed.

Maria (Finance): Closing ticket: we have reprocessed + manual fallback journal. Please add a short runbook note so we can avoid manual steps next month. Nina/Audrey can you collab on the runbook?

Audrey (Engineering): Will do a short postmortem and update the runbook with the key mapping change.

Nina (RevOps): I'll document the temporary manual allocation steps in the finance runbook and include the reconciliation query we used.

Maria (Finance): Awesome — thanks team. :party:
